material: Buddy Talks AUDIO FILE - cat and cake
lesson.introText:
Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll work on two vowels that stay blurred long after fluency arrives. They are... …CAT and CAKE! The contrast survives in real minimal pairs: vanish

Isolated, each word sounds acceptable. Side by side, the difference is obvious. That is why the pair, and not the single word, is the only useful exercise here.
